Most housing loss is predictable — the notice comes weeks before the move. The people who land somewhere are the ones who start early, keep their documents together, and have one person helping them navigate. Records are a barrier, but not every landlord and program screens the same way.

Calling ahead is the single highest-value habit in this whole area.
Call before, not after. Every time.
